# STR Booster

> STR Booster builds and runs growth systems for independent short-term rental property managers with 10 to 100 doors. Two outcomes: more direct revenue (Direct Revenue System) and more owner contracts (Owner Acquisition System), tied together by revenue management in the Growth Partner plan. STR Booster is a division of Green Door Hotel Inc., founded by David Anthony Scott.

## About

- [Homepage](https://strbooster.com/): the two systems, plans, how engagements work and the founder.
- [Systems and pricing](https://strbooster.com/growth-services): Growth Audit (free), Direct Revenue System, Owner Acquisition System and Growth Partner, with starting prices and guarantees.
- [Owner Acquisition System](https://strbooster.com/owner-acquisition): owner landing page, revenue estimate, AI follow-up, nurture for owners and realtors, monthly pipeline report.
- [How we work](https://strbooster.com/our-approach): Growth Audit, build and run.
- [Book a discovery call](https://strbooster.com/get-expert-help): 30-minute call; final scope is confirmed before any work begins.

## What's inside the systems

- [Revenue management](https://strbooster.com/revenue-management): pricing, minimum stays, seasonal strategy and channel mix.
- [Websites and booking funnels](https://strbooster.com/websites-funnels): direct booking websites, lead capture and follow-up.
- [Listing optimization](https://strbooster.com/listing-optimization): ideal-guest positioning, listing copy and photo strategy.
- [Technology and automation](https://strbooster.com/technology-automation): PMS, CRM and AI workflow setup.
